name: defense_book_sector_source_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: DEFENSE_BOOK_SECTOR_SOURCE_20261107 — LQ-20261107-224, the Your-book sector column
on /v3/defense/classic showed "unknown" for SPCX, T, V, ANET, PFE and XAR. The request that
builds the column 500'd on the default sector, and SPCX additionally had no rank to serve:
config/fund_lookthrough.json (seeded 2026-07-18) called it "SPAC and New Issue ETF", a
different instrument sharing the ticker string, with lookthrough "none", while
symbol_profiles (Finviz) and the enrichment cache both called it Space Exploration Technologies
Corp., Industrials / Aerospace & Defense. book_sector_ranks consults the seed before the
profile, so one stale line hid an answer already on file. The tests pin: a blind fund still
renders its reason and is never guessed, an unclaimed symbol resolves from symbol_profiles,
the Finviz name -> ETF-label alias map still applies, effective_sector_exposure books a
company directly only when the seed does not mark it blind, and the shipped seed no longer
blinds SPCX. Hermetic: temporary root, injected cursor, synthetic symbols; no database, no
network, no real instrument names in the fixtures.
